text: どの　わざに　するんだい？

structure.jp: どの　わざに　するんだい？
structure.en: which move will you go with?

patterns.name: 〜にする
patterns.explanation: にする after a thing means to decide on it, to pick it. どの わざに する = 'which move will you pick'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ asks for an explanation, and い after it makes a question word sound soft and friendly. するんだい = 'will you go with, then?'.
